name: Antipodally Punctured Hypercubes
definition: For $n\geq3$, choose an antipodal pair $x,\overline{x}$ in $Q_n$ and take the subgraph induced by $V(Q_n)\setminus\{x,\overline{x}\}$. Its isomorphism type is denoted $Q_n^{--}$.
parameters: Integer $n\geq3$; all choices of the deleted antipodal pair are equivalent under cube automorphisms.
canonical_form: Up to partial-cube isomorphism there is one member $Q_n^{--}$ in each dimension $n\geq3$.
recognition: A certificate is an irredundant $n$-cube embedding whose complement consists of two ambient-antipodal vertices.
comments: These are exactly the nonample members of both the complete daisy basis and the complete convex-treelike basis. They are periphery-free and pc-minimal outside each target class.
